title: Travaux de protection contre la corrosion 2027
description:
Application sur site de revêtements anticorrosion sur les structures métalliques des lignes à haute tension. Description détaillée du projet dans le document C2 « Swissgrid Standard Korrosionsschutzarbeiten » (Norme Swissgrid relative aux travaux de protection anticorrosion) et C3.1 « Leistungsverzeichnis » (Cahier des charges).

title: MP-080229, élargissement à 6 voies du tronçon Luterbach - Härkingen / lot 1.3 installation photovoltaïque tronçon ouestouest
description:
Dans le cadre du projet d'élargissement à six voies Luterbach - Härkingen, la route nationale N01 sera élargie à six voies sur une longueur totale d'environ 21 km. Sur quatre sites du tronçon Ouest, les parois antibruit seront équipées, côté opposé à la chaussée, des quatre installations photovoltaïques suivantes:

  • Frauenholz Ouest, 700 m
  • Frauenholz Est, 2’100 m
  • Pfaffenacher Ouest, 900 m
  • Pfaffenacher Est, 1’000 m


Les fournitures comprennent pour l'essentiel:

  • Env. 1'400 panneaux photovoltaïques (1,7 x 1,1 m, 480 Wc), y compris structure porteuse et sous-structure
  • Câblage DC, mise à la terre / liaison équipotentielle
  • Onduleurs, y compris boîtiers de protection (5 pièces)
  • Enregistreurs de données (3 pièces)

 

Prestations:

  • Cahier des charges de réalisation

  • Étapes de contrôle pour la réception finale (Site Acceptance Test)

title: Germany – Underwear – Lieferung von Wollunterwäsche
description: Dem LZN obliegt die Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen für die unmittelbare niedersächsische Landesverwaltung (vgl. § 2 der Betriebsanweisung des LZN). Mit Zustimmung seiner Aufsichtsbehörde kann das LZN weitere Aufgaben für öffentlich-rechtliche Bedarfsträger innerhalb und außerhalb der niedersächsischen Landesverwaltung sowie für privatrechtliche Gesellschaften in vollständiger Eigentümerschaft der öffentlichen Hand übernehmen (vgl. § 3 Betriebsanweisung). In dieser Zuständigkeit umfasst der Auftrag den Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung mit einem Unternehmen (§ 21 VgV) über die Lieferung von Wollunterwäsche für die Kooperationspartner der norddeutschen Küstenländer der Polizei und Justiz, der Landesforsten und Ordnungsämtern innerhalb von Deutschland und sonstige Behörden (gemäß Anlage) mit einer Preisbindung von 24 Monaten sowie optional zwei einseitige Vertragsverlängerungen zu jeweils höchstens 12 Monaten mit einem Unternehmen. Nähere Einzelheiten zu Art und Umfang des Auftrags sind der Leistungsbeschreibung -Technischer Teil (Teil B) inkl. Angebotsvordruck zu entnehmen. Nähere Einzelheiten zu Art und Umfang des Auftrags sind den technischen Lieferbedingungen und dem Angebotsvordruck zu entnehmen.

title: Germany – Transmission apparatus for radiotelephony, radiotelegraphy, radio broadcasting and television – Aufbau und Erneuerung Sport Campus
description: Auf Beschluss der ARD soll der ARD-SportHub zentral beim WDR in Köln etabliert werden. Ziel des Projekts ist die schrittweise Errichtung einer zukunftsweisenden, crossmedialen Produktionsumgebung für Sportformate. Der Fokus liegt auf der Optimierung redaktioneller, produktions-technischer und infrastruktureller Arbeitsbedingungen sowie der Einführung moderner, Medien-over-IP-basierter Produktionstechnologien. Bereits seit Januar 2025 produziert der WDR alle Sportgroßereignisse für die gesamte ARD, jeweils unter Federführung der zuständigen Landesrundfunkanstalt (LRA). Die neuen Produktionsräume werden in Köln im Gebäude Arkaden, 3.OG, aufgebaut. Der Auftragsgegenstand umfasst neben einer FS-Regie u.a. diverse Multifunktions-räume, einen Dispatcherraum, zwei Hörfunkregien inkl. Studios, ein Podcaststudio und mehrere OffTube Kabinen. Weiterhin ist Bestandteil dieser Ausschreibung die Errichtung von bis zu 50 redaktionellen Arbeitsplätzen in diversen Büros und auf offenen Flächen. Der 2015 in Betrieb genommene Sport Campus im Gebäude Arkaden, 2.OG, bietet aktuell den Platz für alle an den Herstellungsprozessen der WDR-Sportproduktionen beteiligten Fachbereiche (Redaktion, Produktion und Technik). Der vorhandene Raum besteht aus einer großen Open-Space-Fläche mit daran angeschlossenen redaktionellen Arbeitsplätzen, Konferenzräumen und technisch ausgestatteten Produktionseinheiten auf Basis klassischer Broadcasttechnik. Von dort aus werden alle relevanten Ausspielwege, insbesondere für die "Sportschau", "Sportschau.de" und deren Social-Media-Kanälen bedient. Das Herzstück wird die neue Sport Campus Regie auf Basis einer Live-IP-Infrastruktur bilden, die neben ihrer bestehenden Anbindung zur Presenterfläche im Open-Space-Bereich des Sport Campus zusätzlich auf die Studioflächen in der Rechtschule zugreifen soll, um kleinere Produktionen aus der Sportschau-Deko oder aus der Greenbox abzuwickeln. Die weiteren Produktionseinheiten des Sport Campus werden technisch an die neuen Multifunktionsräume im 3.OG angeglichen.

title: Switzerland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Bauherrenvertretung & Projektsteuerung neuer Hauptsitz SZU / neue Instandhaltungsanlage
description: DE: Die bestehende Instandhaltungsanlage am Standort Giesshübel in Zürich ist technisch und betrieblich überholt und erfüllt die zukünftigen Anforderungen an modernes Rollmaterial nicht mehr. Vorgesehen ist der Rückbau der bestehenden Anlage und der Neubau einer zukunftsfähigen Instandhaltungsanlage mit zwei rund 130 m langen Gleisen und Waschanlage. Das Projekt befindet sich in einem innerstädtischen, räumlich stark begrenzten Umfeld mit komplexen Rahmenbedingungen. Gesucht wird eine erfahrene Projektsteuerung / Bauherrenvertretung zur ganzheitlichen Führung des Projekts und optimalen Begleitung dieses vielseitigen komplexen Projektes. Ziel der Beschaffung ist die Beauftragung einer erfahrenen Projektsteuerung / Bauherrenvertretung, welche den Bauherrn bei der Planung und Realisierung der neuen Instandhaltungsanlage ganzheitlich unterstützt und eine zielgerichtete Steuerung von Kosten, Terminen, Qualität und Risiken sicherstellt. Weitere Details zum genauen Umfang entnehmen Sie dem Dokument B1_Lastenheft. FR: L’installation de maintenance existante sur le site de Giesshübel à Zurich est devenue obsolète tant sur le plan technique qu’opérationnel et ne répond plus aux exigences futures du matériel roulant moderne. Le projet prévoit le démantèlement de l’installation existante et la construction d’une nouvelle installation de maintenance pérenne et adaptée aux besoins futurs, comprenant deux voies ferrées d’environ 130 mètres de long ainsi qu’une installation de lavage. Le projet s’inscrit dans un environnement urbain dense, caractérisé par un espace fortement limité et des conditions-cadres complexes. Nous recherchons une équipe expérimentée en gestion de projet / représentation du maître d’ouvrage, capable d’assurer la conduite globale du projet et d’accompagner de manière optimale sa réalisation, compte tenu de sa diversité et de sa complexité. L’objectif du présent marché est de mandater un prestataire expérimenté en gestion de projet / représentation du maître d’ouvrage, chargé d’assister le maître d’ouvrage de manière globale lors de la planification et de la réalisation de la nouvelle installation de maintenance, tout en garantissant un pilotage efficace des coûts, des délais, de la qualité et des risques. Pour plus de détails concernant l’étendue exacte des prestations, veuillez vous référer au document B1_Lastenheft. ENG: The existing maintenance facility at the Giesshübel site in Zurich has become technically and operationally obsolete and no longer meets the future requirements of modern rolling stock. The project the dismantling of the existing facility and the construction of a new, future-proof maintenance facility comprising two railway tracks, each approximately 130 metres long, as well as a washing facility. The project is situated in a densely built-up urban environment with severely limited space and complex boundary conditions. We are seeking an experienced project management / client representation team to provide overall project leadership and ensure optimal support throughout this multifaceted and complex project. The objective of this procurement is to appoint an experienced project management / client representation provider to offer comprehensive support to the client throughout the planning and implementation of the new maintenance facility, ensuring effective management and control of costs, schedules, quality and risks. Further details regarding the exact scope of services can be found in document B1_Lastenheft.

description: La Communauté de Communes Retz-en-Vallois (ci-après la « CCRV ») est l’autorité organisatrice de la mobilité sur son périmètre, comprenant 54 communes. Elle dispose d’un réseau de transport important (réseau Villéo-Retzéo) pour une intercommunalité de cette strate, constitué des services suivants : - - 4 lignes de transport régulier : o 3 lignes de transport régulier (Lignes A, B et C) parcourant la commune de Villers-Cotterêts ; o 1 ligne de transport régulier (Ligne D) reliant la commune de La Ferté-Milon à Villers-Cotterêts. 1 service de transport à la demande (TAD) desservant 3 zones distinctes : o 1 TAD zonal desservant la commune de Villers-Cotterêts (2 zones existantes) ; o 1 TAD zonal desservant la commune de La Ferté-Milon ; o 1 TAD zonal desservant la commune de Vic-sur-Aisne (2 zones existantes). Au-delà du service proposé par la CCRV, deux autres zones présentent des caractéristiques distinctes en matière de service de transport collectif : - - 1 service de TAD géré par le Syndicat Intercommunal des Transports Urbains Soissonnais (ci-après « SITUS »). Ce service mis en œuvre dans le cadre d’une convention SITUS/CCRV dessert 5 communes membres de la CCRV afin de permettre les déplacements vers la commune de Soissons (réseau Flexi’TUS). 7 communes de la CCRV (Ambleny, Bieuxy, Cutry, Epagny, Laversine, Nouvron-Vingré, Vézaponin) faisaient partie d’un programme d’expérimentation de lignes TAD exploitées par le SITUS vers la commune de Soissons. L’expérimentation de ces lignes de TAD n’a pas été prolongée et le service a été arrêté le 1er juillet 2025. Ces 7 communes n’ont donc, actuellement, aucun service de transport proposé, que ce soit par la CCRV ou par le SITUS. Le réseau exploité par la CCRV comprenant les 4 lignes de transport régulier ainsi que les services de TAD (hors SITUS) susvisées, est actuellement exploité dans le cadre d’une concession de type délégation de service public arrivant à échéance au 31 août 2027. La présente consultation (ci-après « la Consultation ») a pour objet de confier, par un contrat de délégation de service public (ci-après « le Contrat ») l’exploitation des services publics de mobilités présentés ci-dessus à un délégataire de service public.

title: Romania – Software programming and consultancy services – Furnizarea de software, licențe și echipamente TIC in cadrul proiectului intitulat: <IMBUNATATIREA ACTIVITATII UAT COMUNA CRICAU, JUD. ALBA, PRIN DIGITALIZARE>
description: UAT Comuna Cricau în calitate de autoritate contractantă dorește atribuirea unui contract de furnizare de software, licențe și echipamente TIC (statii de lucru, senzori de calitate aer, echipament de plata si incasare, echipament server) și servicii conexe, respectiv servicii de instalare programe software și interconectare programe, indiferent dacă sunt cele care fac obiectul contractului sau cele deja instalate, respectiv integrarea aplicațiilor noi cu aplicațiile existente, realizând o platformă de servicii online funcțională, implementarea unui sistem informatic integrat, necesare pentru implementarea proiectului „IMBUNATATIREA ACTITIVATII UAT COMUNA CRICAU, JUD. ALBA, PRIN DIGITALIZARE” Cod SMIS: 333734. In acest context, pentru realizarea acestei achizitii se identifica posibilitatea impartirea activitatilor aferente procedurii de achizitie publica in 2 loturi, astfel: lot nr. 1 - Realizare API de interoperabilitate pentru sistemele existente si realizarea unui sistem de gestiune a bazelor de date ; lot nr.2 - Realizarea unei solutii informatice de interactiune cu cetatenii; Obiectivul general constă în îmbunătățirea continuă a calității vieții pentru generațiile prezente și viitoare, pentru crearea unor comunități durabile, capabile să gestioneze și să folosească resursele în mod eficient și să valorifice potențialul de inovare ecologică și socială al economiei, în vederea asigurării prosperității, protecției mediului și coeziunii sociale. Obiectivul se realizează prin dezvoltarea unor soluții digitale pentru serviciile publice locale – servicii de e-guvernare și servicii digitale noi, accesibile nemijlocit cetățenilor.În ceea ce privește necesitatea la nivelul comunei, echipamentele prezente sunt neschimbate de ani de zile și nu acoperă numărul angajaților care au nevoie de acestea, astfel muncă acestora desfășurându-se pe hârtie, fiind nevoie de spații fizice de stocare în ceea ce privește lucrul cu cetățenii căutarea și documentarea la nivelul instituției necesitând mai mult timp din cauza procesului anevoios. Prin folosirea unei soluții informatizate de gestiune a documentelor, se urmărește ca timpii de regăsire a informației să scadă cu cel puțin 50%, iar aprobarea documentelor să poată fi urmărită in timp real. Prin implementarea acestui proiect, UAT Comuna Cricau, jud. Alba, urmărește atingerea următoarelor obiective specifice: - Asigurarea fluxurilor digitale de date și documente între cetățenii comunei și autoritatea locală, respectiv schimbul interdepartamental de date între sistemele informatice existente; - Utilizarea unor sisteme de management integrat al comunității, inclusiv al bunurilor publice; - Integrarea unor tehnologii lingvistice bazate pe inteligență artificială menite să faciliteze interacțiunea; - Valoarea adăugată; In urma implementării proiectului este preconizată realizarea următoarelor beneficii: - Reducerea birocrației prin transferul interacțiunii între cetățean și administrația publică în mediul digital ca urmare a implementării unei platforme de servicii electronice integrate cu aplicațiile back-end existente; - Reducerea birocrației prin simplificarea fluxurilor de date și documente în interiorul autorității locale la nivel interdepartamental și deschiderea către colaborarea electronică cu alte instituții prin adoptarea de standarde deschise de comunicare; - Creșterea eficienței managementului integrat al comunității, inclusiv al bunurilor publice prin implementarea unei platforme integrate de management urban bazată pe tehnologii și standarde deschise, respectiv printr-o comunicare mai bună cu cetățenii, inclusiv prin colectarea de feedback, implicarea acestora în procesul de luare a deciziilor și culegerea, respectiv publicarea de date deschise și crowdsourcing. - Accesibilizarea serviciilor digitale pentru persoanele cu dizabilități și cele aparținând categoriilor defavorizate.

title: Netherlands – Recruitment services – Brugbediening
description: De gemeente Nieuwegein heeft sinds 2021 een overeenkomst voor de dienstverlening voor de uitvoering en borging van de benodigde brugbediencapaciteit, welke eind april 2027 afloopt. Ter waarborging van het op een rechtmatige en doelmatige manier blijven invullen van de benodigde brugbediencapaciteit voor de komende jaren wordt de opdracht opnieuw in de markt belegd. De opdracht heeft betrekking op het beschikbaar stellen, organiseren en waarborgen van voldoende gekwalificeerde brugbediencapaciteit voor de uitvoering van de brugbedieningswerkzaamheden binnen het bedieningsgebied, inclusief de daarmee samenhangende personele en operationele coördinatie, planning, roostering, vervanging, continuïteitsborging en kwaliteitsborging. Hiervoor wenst de gemeente met één (1) opdrachtnemer een Raamovereenkomst af te sluiten. De waarde van de opdracht wordt geraamd op een inzet van 9.200 uren per jaar en 36.800 uren over vier (4) jaar. De geraamde jaarlijkse afname is daarmee € 450.000, - (excl. BTW). De totale geraamde waarde over de gehele looptijd van de opdracht (4 jaar) is daarmee € 1.800.000, - (excl. BTW). De geraamde waarde is gebaseerd op de verwachte benodigde dienstverlening, historische afname en kosten en huidige uurtarieven in de markt. Ingeval wij meer dan 200% boven de hierboven geraamde totale contractwaarde uitkomen, zal een nieuwe aanbesteding worden opgezet. De maximale afname onder de Raamovereenkomst bedraagt daarmee € 3.600.000, - (excl. BTW).

The full list of spare parts can be found in Appendix 2. Appendix 2 specifies which parts are required to be delivered as Spare parts (tab 1-3). Appendix 2 also specifies which parts are required to be repaired and/or re-engineered (tab 4-5), and which parts are required to be attempted repaired or re-engineered (tab 6) based on whether the Spare parts are expected to be partially or fully obsolete. The contract will include clauses regarding • Quality Management System • Price regulation based on indexation, as well as extraordinary circumstances (hardship) if prices of materials and shipping increase drastically . • DSB’s Ethical Guidelines (Code of Conduct) • Railway Safety • Warranty (24 months for all parts, excluding repaired rotables, which will have a 12 month warranty) • Penalty for delays • Suppliers insurance for liability, covering no less than DKK 50 mill per occurrence and in the annual aggregate. • DSB’s right to audit Siemens is the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) supplier of the Spare Parts listed in Appendix 2, including Traction & SIBAS parts for the S-trains. DSB has limited or no documentation of the OEM Traction & SIBAS parts and limited access and no rights to protocols and software in relation to the OEM, Traction & SIBAS parts. However, DSB will provide available access for inspection of both systems after prequalification. To avoid time-consuming and expensive safety processes the Spare Parts and components must be OEM or equivalent. The contract value for the entire duration of the contract, is estimated to be between DKK 125 mill. and DKK 175 mill.

title: Anskaffelse av bistand til mobilisering og kompetanseheving i "Satsing Leverandørutvikling Finnmark" 2027-2030
description: Satsing Leverandørutvikling Finnmark er en videreføring av erfaringer og kompetanse opparbeidet gjennom "Prosjekt Leverandørutvikling Forsvaret". Prosjektet ble gjennomført i perioden 2020-2023 i Troms og Finnmark fylkeskommune, med bakgrunn i re-etableringen av Finnmark Landforsvar på Porsangmoen. Satsingen har til hensikt å øke den lokale verdiskapingen gjennom forsvarssektorens økende tilstedeværelse i Finnmark. Satsingen skal også bidra til at andre offentlige oppdragsgivere i Finnmark utnytter mulighetene for å gjøre innkjøp fra lokalt næringsliv. Hovedmålet for satsingen er å få flere lokale små og mellomstore bedrifter inn i leverandørporteføljen til forsvarssektoren og andre offentlige oppdragsgivere i Finnmark. Satsingen skal bidra til å øke lokal og regional verdiskapning i Finnmark. I tillegg har satsingen beredskapsmessige og sikkerhetspolitiske aspekter ved at et velutviklet regionalt og lokalt samfunns- og næringsliv bidrar til samfunnets totalberedskap.

title: Utskifting av ventilasjonsaggregater 36.01 og 36.02 – Atlanterhavsbadet
description: Bakgrunn Kristiansund kommune v/ Eiendomsdrift skal skifte ut eksisterende ventilasjons- og avfuktingsaggregater 36.01 og 36.02 ved Atlanterhavsbadet. Aggregatene er fra 2004 og er preget av alder og slitasje. Utskiftingen er nødvendig for å sikre stabil drift, tilfredsstillende luftkvalitet og god regulering av temperatur og luftfuktighet i bassengområdene. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å oppgradere ventilasjonsløsningen, forbedre energieffektiviteten og sikre driftssikre aggregater som er tilpasset et krevende bassengmiljø. Nye aggregater skal ha egnet materialkvalitet og korrosjonsbeskyttelse for kontinuerlig drift i fuktige og klorholdige omgivelser. Atlanterhavsbadet skal så langt som mulig opprettholde ordinær drift under utskiftingen. Arbeidene må derfor gjennomføres etappevis, med hensyn til begrenset tilkomst til tekniske rom, eksisterende installasjoner, sikkerhet og nødvendig koordinering med oppdragsgiver og eventuelle sideentreprenører. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Oppdraget omfatter prosjektering, dimensjonering, levering, demontering, inntransport, montering, idriftsettelse og dokumentasjon av nye ventilasjons- og avfuktingsaggregater for system 36.01 og 36.02 ved Atlanterhavsbadet. Leveransen skal gjennomføres som en samlet aggregatleveranse med prosjekterings-, monterings-, koordinerings- og funksjonsansvar innenfor de grensesnittene som er definert i konkurransegrunnlaget. Utskiftingen skal gjennomføres trinnvis, med aggregat 36.01 først og deretter 36.02, slik at badeanleggets drift påvirkes minst mulig. Leveransen omfatter blant annet: Komplette ventilasjons- og avfuktingsaggregater for system 36.01 og 36.02, inkludert nødvendig intern automatikk. Prosjektering og dimensjonering av tilbudt løsning, tilpasset ventilasjons- og avfuktingsbehovet i bassengområdene. Demontering av eksisterende aggregater, inntransport og montering av nye aggregater. Dokumentasjon av kapasitet, SFP-verdi, temperaturvirkningsgrad, varmegjenvinning, kuldemedium, materialvalg og korrosjonsbeskyttelse. Dokumentasjon av moduloppdeling, transportvei, inntransport, serviceareal og montasjeprinsipp. Koordinering mot eksisterende kanalnett, røranlegg, elektro, automasjon og SD-anlegg innenfor avtalte grensesnitt. Innregulering, funksjonstesting, idriftsettelse og prøvedrift. FDV-dokumentasjon og nødvendig opplæring av driftspersonell. Aggregatene skal være egnet for kontinuerlig drift i fuktig og klorholdig bassengmiljø, ha høy energieffektivitet og kunne integreres med eksisterende tekniske anlegg innenfor leverandørens ansvarsområde. Arbeider utenfor aggregatleverandørens definerte grensesnitt, herunder større kanaltilpasninger og nødvendige rør-, elektro- og bygningsmessige arbeider, utføres normalt av oppdragsgivers rammeavtalepartnere eller andre entreprenører, slik det fremgår av kravspesifikasjonen og prisskjemaet. Leverandøren skal utarbeide en gjennomføringsplan som beskriver hovedaktiviteter, rekkefølge, forventet nedetid og nødvendige tiltak for å ivareta drift og sikkerhet under utskiftingen. Planen skal også beskrive koordineringen med oppdragsgiver og eventuelle sideentreprenører. Nærmere krav til leveransen, tekniske spesifikasjoner, ansvarsfordeling og dokumentasjon fremgår av konkurransegrunnlagets del II, herunder II.30 Kravspesifikasjon VVS, prisskjema, miljøskjema og tilhørende tegninger, rapporter og øvrige vedlegg.

title: France – Public road transport services – DELEGATION DE SERVICE PUBLIC RELATIVE A LA GESTION ET L’EXPLOITATIONDES SERVICES DE MOBILITE ET DE TRANSPORT DE VOYAGEURS SUR LETERRITOIRE DE CHATEAUROUX METROPOLE
description: La consultation a pour objet de déléguer la gestion et l’exploitation des services de mobilité et de transport de voyageurs sur le ressort territorial de la Communauté d’Agglomération de Châteauroux Métropole (Réseau Horizon) Châteauroux Métropole, autorité Organisatrice de la mobilité est autorité délégante. Les missions déléguées sont les suivantes: Offre de base : Exploitation et gestion des services de mobilité et de transports publics de personnes et à l’échelle du territoire communautaire selon les principes définis à l’article 5.1 du document programme. Les candidats devront obligatoirement répondre à l’offre de base et à l'option obligatoire.• Option obligatoire :Option N°1 : Exploitation et gestion d’un service de location de vélos L’option est décrite à l’article 5.2 du document programme. L’Autorité Délégante précisera, avant la remise de l'offre finale si l'option est levée. Le Délégataire assurera la gestion de ces services pour une durée de six (6) ans, à compter du 01/01/2028 et jusqu’au 31/12/2033 dans le cadre d’une délégation de service public (DSP) au sein du périmètre contractuel. Lieu d’exécution : Territoire de la Communauté d’Agglomération de Châteauroux Métropole(département de l’Indre). L’estimation de la valeur du contrat de concession est de 45 millions d’euros HT valeur décembre 2026 sur la durée du contrat. Les missions attendues sont l'organisation, la production et la commercialisation des services, ainsi que la réalisation de l'offre de transport et la maintenance des véhicules et outils de production.Le délégataire assurera en outre la gestion de la relation avec les usagers des transports scolaires qui sont assurés par le biais de marchés publics en cours. La future DSP intègre la gestion et l'exploitation des services de transport suivants sur l’ensemble du périmètre de l’Agglomération de Châteauroux Métropole : • Le réseau de transport en commun « Horizon » composé aujourd’hui de 12 lignes régulières, • Le service de transport adapté à la demande, « Handibus », à destination des personnes à mobilité réduite sur le périmètre de CM .Pour cette gestion déléguée, la collectivité met à la disposition du délégataire : • Un dépôt de bus réceptionné en 2021 avec une capacité de stationnement de 80 véhicules, équipé de bureaux, d’un atelier de maintenance, de stations de lavage et de carburant et d’équipements de recharge de véhicule électrique; • 31 autobus standard, 5 autobus articulé, 2 midibus. Ces véhicules sont équipés d’équipements de suivi par système SAEIV et cellules de comptage voyageurs. Plusieurs véhicules standard et articulés électriques ont également été commandés. • 2 midibus accessibles et équipés pour accueillir des PMR • Un Site Internet https://www.bushorizon.com/ La présente concession est passée sur le fondement du règlement 1370/2007 et de la directive 2014/23/CEE. La directive 2014/25/UE citée dans le présent avis concerne les marchés des secteurs spéciaux est non les concessions , elle ne s'applique pas à la présente consultation.

title: Construction Management Services - Pointe-de-Longueuil
description: The Corporation intends to retain the services of a Construction Manager (the “Construction Manager”) for the execution of work related to the redevelopment of a former Transport Canada site known as Pointe-de-Longueuil, located in Longueuil, Québec. This Request for Proposals (the “RFP”) is intended to solicit proposals for construction management services related to the planning, coordination, and execution of the work associated with the Project. The Project will be carried out using a phased approach. Subject to obtaining all required authorizations and approvals, the first phase is expected to commence in the spring of 2027 and will include, among other things, preparatory works, environmental remediation activities, and the design and construction of the horizontal infrastructure required to support the future development of the Site. The Construction Manager will be responsible for the overall management of the work. In this capacity, the Construction Manager will oversee the planning and coordination of construction activities, site logistics and traffic management, implementation and monitoring of health and safety measures, support for procurement and contract award processes, as well as supervision of the execution of infrastructure works. The complete redevelopment of the Site is expected to take place over a period of approximately 10 to 15 years and will be implemented through several subsequent phases. Upon completion, the Project will result in the creation of a mixed-use community incorporating residential, commercial, institutional, and community components, as well as high-quality public spaces, contributing to the revitalization and sustainable development of the area.

title: R799--East Orange EUL Development Opportunity Sources Sought COR: Sharon Sirotnak
description: East Orange, NJ EUL Request for Expressions of Interest DRAFT PRE-DECISIONAL INTERNAL VA USE ONLY 1 REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST ENHANCED-USE LEASE DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITY VA New Jersey Healthcare System (VANJHCS) within Veterans Integrated Service Network 2 (VISN 2) East Orange, NJ VA Medical Center (VAMC) located within East Orange, NJ Notice This advertisement is a notice of a potential opportunity. This Request for Expressions of Interest (the advertisement ) is not a solicitation for offers, nor is it a request for proposals. Respondents are advised that the Government assumes no responsibility to award an Enhanced-Use Lease (EUL) based upon responses to this advertisement. This Sources Sought Notice is to identify potential sources for information and planning purposes only and is not intended to pre-qualify or disqualify any potential Respondents. The purpose of this Sources Sought is to conduct market research to determine if there are responsible and qualified entities interested in redeveloping the asset described in Section III and if yes, what potential reuse options exist. The information gained from this Sources Sought will be used to assist the Government in determining if this development opportunity can be competitive and/or a total Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) or Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) Set-Aside. The Government will use this information to determine the best acquisition strategy for this procurement and to inform related asset management decision-making. The Government requests that interested parties respond to this Notice with the specific information requested in Section V of this Notice and identify their small business status. VA is particularly interested in SDVOSB/VOSB respondents capabilities to perform a minimum of 51% of the development opportunity described in this Notice. Developers responding to this market research should be aware that responding to this advertisement may not ensure that they qualify for any underlying future solicitation or contract award. Responding to this Sources Sought Notice is NOT a prerequisite to respond to any future subsequent solicitations. The Government will not reimburse participants for any expenses associated with their participation in this Sources Sought. The Government cannot provide any warranty, expressed or implied, as to the accuracy, reliability or completeness of the information contained in this Notice. Overview and Objectives The United States Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), under its Enhanced-Use Leasing (EUL) authority (38 U.S.C. §§ 8161- 8169, as amended), is seeking expressions of interest from qualified developers, including SDVOSBs and VOSBs, to serve as a Developer for purposes of developing administrative and/or educational purposes, or other uses that directly or indirectly benefit Veterans (e.g., technical skills / job training centers, research facilities, mixed-use, other). Parking is limited on the campus and if redevelopment would result in significantly increased demand for parking, parking must be included within the footprint. For purposes of this effort, the Developer would be a non-VA entity who has the qualifications outlined in Section V of this Notice. The opportunity would involve a Developer entering into an EUL with VA and financing, renovating/constructing, operating, and maintaining the agreed upon use of the asset. VA s EUL authority allows VA to outlease land and improvements to selected developers (i.e., Lessees) to provide housing and/or other uses that directly or indirectly benefit Veterans. Such leases can have a term of up to 99 years. VA s Office of Asset Enterprise Management (OAEM) administers the EUL Program. The objective of this development opportunity is to repurpose an asset at the East Orange VAMC Campus under VA s EUL Program to the benefit of Veterans. Respondents should consider the following as they formulate responses to this Notice: Lease-back by VA or other Federal government entities is not permissible, and financing cannot reflect a lease-back arrangement. The PACT Act does not nullify 38 U.S.C. § 8162(b)(5), which states, "The terms of an enhanced-use lease may not provide for any acquisition, contract, demonstration, exchange, grant, incentive, procurement, sale, other transaction authority, service agreement, use agreement, lease, or lease-back by the Secretary or Federal Government. VA may only receive cash consideration for ground lease rent in an EUL (per 38 U.S.C. § 8162(b)(3)(B)). This means VA cannot receive any in-kind consideration or free/discounted services as part of a new EUL agreement. However, projects may provide free or discounted services to individual Veterans or Veteran Service Organizations, and the Secretary may enter into an EUL without receiving consideration per U.S.C. § 8162(b)(3)(C). Additional information on the VA s EUL program may be obtained at: http://www.va.gov/assetmanagement/. Development Scope The intent of this Notice is to determine if there are experienced developers, including SDVOSB or VOSB developers, that can develop the subject Campus asset in accordance with VA s EUL authority. The Developer would undertake all necessary investigation activities to produce development with the underutilized asset at the East Orange Campus. The asset that may be redeveloped by the Developer includes Building 11 (Note: The building is currently listed on the National Register of Historic Places). Please see Attachment A for a map of the Campus and Attachment B for asset information and photos. East Orange VA Medical Center Background The East Orange VA Medical Center located at 385 Tremont Avenue, East Orange, NJ 07018-1023 includes ~34 acres situated on a knoll at South Center Street and Tremont Avenue, 228 feet above sea level. The campus overlooks a residential area with views of the Manhattan skyline on the horizon. The grounds are in four municipalities: Orange, East Orange, South Orange, and Newark. The site formerly belonged to the Bamberger estate, which was endowed originally to Princeton University and in turn, sold to a private owner and then purchased by the government. Recognizing the need for a medical facility to serve Veterans in metropolitan areas, Congress approved and funded the facility in 1943. The VAMC opened in July 1952. The hospital provides primary care and specialty health services, including homeless Veteran care, mental health care, skin care (dermatology), dental care, digestive care (gastroenterology), cardiology, eye health and vision care (ophthalmology and optometry), palliative and hospice care, returning service member care, Veteran readiness and employment programs, and more. Sources Sought Response Requirements VA is seeking qualified developers who have a proven company track record of: Developing projects comparable to the proposed use(s) for the designated asset. Financial wherewithal required to successfully develop the proposed use(s) with associated amenities (if applicable); and, Securing public and private financing for projects comparable to the proposed use(s) for the designated asset. For SDVOSB/VOSB developers, VA is seeking to confirm the Respondent s ability to perform a minimum of 51% of the development opportunity described in this Notice. Responses should be submitted on official letterhead, must include a point of contact and the signature of at least one organization officer. description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes Residential Reentry Center Services located within Sacramento County and other border Counties of San Jaquin, Sutter, Yolo, Solano, Placer, El Dorado, and Amador. Home Confinement within 150 miles of the RRC Facility. Both the RRC services for in-house RRC beds and the Home Confinement services for home confinement placements shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work (SOW) entitled, �Residential Reentry Center, March 2022�. Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, programs, of the SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be a Firm-Fixed Price/IDIQ contract for services with a one-year base period, and four one-year options periods. The RRC In-House requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 16 beds in which 14 beds will be designated for males and 2 beds designated for females and an estimated maximum 40 bed facility in which 34 beds will be designated for males and 6 beds designated for females. The Home Confinement requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 8 placements and an estimated maximum 20 placements to include both male and female. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC in-house beds and home confinement placements) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. The Government reserves the right to potentially make an award which is deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. The closing date of 15BRRC26R00000019 is January 08, 2027 at 2:00pm EST. title: Northwest Division Powerhouse Life Safety Upgrades Stage 1
description: Northwest Division Powerhouse Life Safety Upgrades Stage 1The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Walla Walla District, intends to issue a single-phase solicitation on or about 30 November 2026 for a Construction Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple-Award Task Order Contract (MATOC).The anticipated MATOC will provide construction services for renovation and upgrade projects at hydroelectric powerhouses located at large, remote civil works projects within the Northwestern Division. The primary area of performance is anticipated to include USACE Walla Walla District projects at McNary, Ice Harbor, Lower Monumental, Little Goose, Lower Granite, and Dworshak. Task orders may also include work at other USACE projects within the Pacific Northwest, including locations within the Seattle and Portland Districts in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, and Montana.The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Walla Walla District, anticipates awarding up to four (4) IDIQ MATOCs. At least one, and up to two, MATOCs will be reserved for award to qualified small business concerns. Task orders issued under the MATOCs will be firm-fixed-price.The aggregate shared contract capacity for all awarded MATOCs is anticipated to be $99 million. Each contract is anticipated to include a 36-month base period and two (2) 24-month option periods, exercisable at the Governments discretion. The Government may issue individual task orders with values up to $25,000,000.The Government reserves the right to issue additional solicitations and award additional contracts for the same or similar work within the geographic area covered by the MATOCs. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. This notice is for informational purposes only and is not a solicitation. The solicitation is anticipated to be issued on or about 30 November 2026.Summary Scope of Work:The purpose of this IDIQ MATOC is to provide construction services to renovate and upgrade life-safety systems at large hydroelectric powerhouses located at large, remote civil works projects. These powerhouses may range in size from 75,000 square feet to 420,000 square feet and from 5 stories to 11 stories. The work may consist of the following major industrial construction elements for installation and/or modification:1. Fire detection and mass notification alarm systems2. Wet pipe, fine water mist, and clean agent sprinkler fire suppression system(s)3. Smoke control system, including stair pressurization fans, smoke exhaust fans, motorized fire-smoke dampers, and complex logic and programming matrix digital controls4. HVAC direct digital controls5. HVAC ventilation and conditioning equipment, dampers, and ductwork6. Fabricated steel stairs and guardrails7. Architectural fire barrier walls, fire doors, safety glazing and finishes8. Firestopping9. Emergency and exit lighting systems10. Electrical power supply and distribution11. Precast concrete12. Low-slope roofing13. Specific aspects of this project that may be especially challenging include: a. Robust industrial safety protocols with rigorous lockout tagout proceduresb. Construction in a continuously operating industrial environmentc. Proximity to high voltage equipment and transmission linesd. Multiple underground levels with limited accesse. Fire alarm designers and installers must be NICET Level III or IV certifiedf. title: Northwest Division Powerhouse Life Safety Upgrades Stage 1
description: Northwest Division Powerhouse Life Safety Upgrades Stage 1 The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Walla Walla District, intends to issue a single-phase solicitation on or about 30 November 2026 for a Construction Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple-Award Task Order Contract (MATOC). The anticipated MATOC will provide construction services for renovation and upgrade projects at hydroelectric powerhouses located at large, remote civil works projects within the Northwestern Division. The primary area of performance is anticipated to include USACE Walla Walla District projects at McNary, Ice Harbor, Lower Monumental, Little Goose, Lower Granite, and Dworshak. Task orders may also include work at other USACE projects within the Pacific Northwest, including locations within the Seattle and Portland Districts in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, and Montana. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Walla Walla District, anticipates awarding up to four (4) IDIQ MATOCs. At least one, and up to two, MATOCs will be reserved for award to qualified small business concerns. Task orders issued under the MATOCs will be firm-fixed-price. The aggregate shared contract capacity for all awarded MATOCs is anticipated to be $99 million. Each contract is anticipated to include a 36-month base period and two (2) 24-month option periods, exercisable at the Governments discretion. The Government may issue individual task orders with values up to $25,000,000. The Government reserves the right to issue additional solicitations and award additional contracts for the same or similar work within the geographic area covered by the MATOCs. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. This notice is for informational purposes only and is not a solicitation. The solicitation is anticipated to be issued on or about 30 November 2026. Summary Scope of Work: The purpose of this IDIQ MATOC is to provide construction services to renovate and upgrade life-safety systems at large hydroelectric powerhouses located at large, remote civil works projects. These powerhouses may range in size from 75,000 square feet to 420,000 square feet and from 5 stories to 11 stories. The work may consist of the following major industrial construction elements for installation and/or modification: 1. Fire detection and mass notification alarm systems 2. Wet pipe, fine water mist, and clean agent sprinkler fire suppression system(s) 3. Smoke control system, including stair pressurization fans, smoke exhaust fans, motorized fire-smoke dampers, and complex logic and programming matrix digital controls 4. HVAC direct digital controls 5. HVAC ventilation and conditioning equipment, dampers, and ductwork 6. Fabricated steel stairs and guardrails 7. Architectural fire barrier walls, fire doors, safety glazing and finishes 8. Firestopping 9. Emergency and exit lighting systems 10. Electrical power supply and distribution 11. Precast concrete 12. Low-slope roofing 13. Specific aspects of this project that may be especially challenging include: a. Robust industrial safety protocols with rigorous lockout tagout procedures b. Construction in a continuously operating industrial environment c. Proximity to high voltage equipment and transmission lines d. Multiple underground levels with limited access e. Fire alarm designers and installers must be NICET Level III or IV certified f. Work in ceilings up to 60 feet high The project will involve the development and management of Contractor furnished submittals for items such as shop drawings, product data, commissioning plans, and contract close-out documentation as required by technical specifications of the task orders. Miscellaneous work within the project includes the delivery of Record Drawings. Placement of Task Orders. The actual amount of work to be performed and the time of such performance will be determined by a Contracting Officer who will issue written task orders. Prices will be requested and evaluated for each task order in accordance with FAR 16.505. The Government will evaluate price and past performance at a minimum but may include additional non-price factors. Each RFP will state the method of selection and any additional non-price factors. Whenever possible, award will be made without discussions. If discussions are required, each contractor included in the competitive range will be requested to provide a final proposal revision, unless eliminated from discussions. title: F-15EX Missile Warning System
description: The Department of the Air Force, Air Force Materiel Command (AFMC), Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC), Fighters & Advanced Aircraft Directorate (AFLCMC/WA), F?15 System Program Office (AFLCMC/WAQ), Wright-Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB) is seeking sources for the procurement of an operationally qualified threat missile launch and approach warning system for rapid integration into the United States Air Force (USAF) F-15EX Eagle II fighter aircraft. INTRODUCTION: This is a SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT to acquire a missile warning system (MWS) to be integrated into the F-15EX fleet. The system must alert the F-15EX aircrew to missile threats without unreasonably distracting the aircrew with false alarms. The MWS must use the six pre-existing sensor locations, data cables, power cables, and cooling. The MWS must be easily, safely, rapidly, and organically installable and removable in the field by USAF military aircraft maintenance personnel. In accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation Overhaul (RFO) Part 10, Market Research, AFLCMC/WAQ is seeking information for potential sources for an integrated MWS solution for the F-15EX. This publication is intended to elicit responses from sources with knowledge, skills, data, equipment, access to appropriate facilities, and the capacity to meet the Air Force�s requirements. The dollar value and period of performance (PoP) for the contract will be commensurate with the requirement. This contract effort is subject to RFO 52.232-18, Availability of Funds. 1.1 SOURCES SOUGHT INFORMATION 1.2 DISCLAIMER: THIS?SOURCES SOUGHT?IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY.? THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP), REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ) OR AN INVITATION FOR BID (IFB).?IN ACCORDANCE WITH?RFO 15.101(c),?THIS NOTICE?DOES NOT CONSTITUTE SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. RESPONSES IN ANY FORM ARE NOT OFFERS AND THE GOVERNMENT IS UNDER NO OBLIGATION TO AWARD A CONTRACT AS A RESULT OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION OF RESPONSES TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY. THE GOVERNMENT MAY USE THE INFORMATION OBTAINED FROM RESPONSES TO THIS NOTICE IN DETERMINING ITS ACQUISITION APPROACH.? THE ISSUANCE OF THIS NOTICE DOES NOT RESTRICT THE GOVERNMENT ACQUISTION APPROACH.? 1.3 REQUIRED CAPABILITIES Interested firms should submit information as to the capabilities, capacity, and experience to provide an MWS as set forth below: The MWS must alert the F-15EX aircrew to the presence of missiles that may threaten the aircraft without unreasonably distracting the aircrew with false alarms. The MWS must use the six (6) pre-existing F-15EX sensor locations, data cables, power cables, and cooling. It must be easily, safely, rapidly, and organically installable and removable in the field by USAF military aircraft maintenance personnel without requiring any change to aircraft configuration beyond installation of MWS line replaceable units (LRUs) in the six (6) pre-existing locations in the aircraft dedicated for missile warning. To avoid compromise of classified information, this notice does not ask for threat missile launch and approach detection performance for various use cases nor for an MWS concept of operations. AFLCMC/WAQ may contact you to ask for detection performance information if your response to this Sources Sought notice indicates your MWS is integrable in an F-15EX aircraft. Questions: What is the name of the MWS you describe in your response to this Sources Sought notice? Please include titles, abbreviations, and nomenclature as available. Please only identify and describe a single MWS in your response. On what Department of War (DoW) aircraft model(s) is your MWS approved for operational use today? Approval for operational use requires both 1) determination of airworthiness of the aircraft with your MWS integrated and 2) sustainment of the aircraft�s cybersecurity Authorization to Operate. Who are the best references (name, position, organization, commercial telephone number, and US Government email address) for DoW acquirers responsible for procuring your MWS for operational use on DoW aircraft named in question 2? Is your MWS in active production today? How many months from contract award could your MWS be delivered? Does your MWS consist only of sensor LRUs or does your MWS consist of sensor LRUs connected to a central processing LRU? If MWS sensors are connected to a central processor, how are they connected? What are the dimensions of each LRU in your MWS? You are alternately welcome to include in your response figures from engineering drawings that identify dimensions, rather than listing dimensions. How much does each LRU in your MWS weigh? How are your MWS�s LRUs physically fastened to an aircraft? What are your MWS�s electrical power requirements? Through what cable connection(s) is your MWS powered by the aircraft? What are your MWS�s cooling requirements? Through what interface(s) is your MWS cooled by the aircraft? Can your MWS be connected to an aircraft�s MIL-STD-1553 avionics bus? What are the terms by which your firm will share the MIL-STD-1553 avionics bus interface specification for your MWS with The Boeing Company so data can be exchanged between your MWS and the F-15EX�s onboard mission computer? Does your MWS require the aircrew or maintenance personnel to provide information to your MWS during aircraft preflight or midflight for it to correctly detect missiles that may threaten the aircraft? If so, how is this information provided to your MWS? Does the installation on, operation of, or removal of your MWS from an aircraft expose personnel to a known health or safety hazard? Are there any known limitations on your MWS�s use in the F-15EX aircraft�s operational environment as verified in accordance with MIL-STD-810H? Does a field-executable procedure exist today for verifying the correct operation of your MWS during aircraft preflight or periodic inspection? If so, please briefly summarize the procedure. Does installation or removal of your MWS require any specific tools that are not commercially available? If yes, please identify the tools and tool vendors. Are there any known limitations on your MWS� storage environment when MWS LRUs are not installed on an aircraft? What are your plans (if any) for adapting your MWS to meet the architecture and interface requirements of the Agile Mission Suite Government Reference Architecture (https://open-arsenal.gitlab.io/platforms/)? 1.4 NORTH?AMERICAN INDUSTRY?CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM?CODE?(NAICS):? The anticipated NAICS Code is?334511; the corresponding Small Business size?standard in?1350 employes. title: RFP to Lease the Armstrong Dune Shack in Cape Cod National Seashore
description: SUMMARY OF LEASING OPPORTUNITY This Request for Proposals (RFP) provides the opportunity for any interested individual or organization, hereinafter referred to as �Offeror� to submit proposals to the National Park Service (NPS, �Lessor�) to lease NPS property at Cape Cod National Seashore for private, residential use and occupancy, under the following general terms and conditions. The selected offeror (Offeror,�you�,�your�) will have exclusive negotiation rights to enter a lease based on the attached Sample Lease (See Attachment A). Elements of your proposal may be incorporated into the Lease at Lessor�s discretion. Overview of Property Offered for Lease The �David and Connie Armstrong� (Armstrong) dune shack located with the Peaked Hill Bars Historic District of the Cape Cod National Seashore is available for lease to the public. The Peaked Hill Bars Historic District was determined to be eligible for the National Register of Historic Places in 1989 with formal listing in 2011. The Armstrong dune shack, located in Truro, MA, is one of eighteen (18) dune shacks located within the Historic District and listed on the National Register. It is the only Cape Cod National Seashore dune shack offered for lease at this time. The dune shack structures promote a simpler way of life. They lack many modern conveniences and amenities and have no municipal or commercial utilities. Access by motorized vehicle requires an NPS-issued off-road-vehicle (ORV) permit for the inner dune route, and a qualified 4-wheel drive truck, SUV, or car with appropriately aired down tires. Dune shacks are generally suitable to be used from Memorial Day to Labor Day. Access to the shacks during the off-season is predominantly for the purpose of maintenance, particularly to prepare for or clean-up after severe weather. Most dune shack occupants start the process of opening shacks for the summer beginning in April and securing them for the winter during the month of October. The Armstrong dune shack is the furthest east and most secluded shack in the district, standing approximately a half mile from its nearest neighbor. It is two stories; the upper level serves as the living area and the partial lower level is used for service and storage. The living space contains a wood-burning stove, water storage facilities and a gravity fed shower and toilet. A wrap-around deck serves as a seating and access area. Additional property details and site maps can be found in the Appendix. Allowed Uses of the Lease Premises Lessee may use the dune shack for private occupancy, in accordance with federal, state and local law. The dune shack must be maintained and operated as a traditional dune shack. Neither the property nor the lessee�s inner dune driving privileges may be used for commercial activities that provide goods, services, agreements or other functions for members, clients, or the public resulting in compensation, monetary gain, benefit or profit unless authorized via a separately obtained Commercial Use Authorization. Subleasing will not be allowed. Information regarding Commercial Use Authorizations (CUA) or Special Use Permits (SUP), can be found at these two sites: https://www.nps.gov/caco/getinvolved/commercial-use-authorizations.htm and https://www.nps.gov/caco/planyourvisit/special-use-permits.htm Key Information About This Leasing Opportunity Planned NPS Improvements: The property will be delivered to the Lessee �as-is with all faults�. Lessee Improvements: Subject to NPS approval, Lessee will be permitted to make Improvements subject to Building Code & Zoning and Historic Preservation guidelines provided below. Rent may be offset by the NPS-approved cost of completed Initial Improvements specified in the Appendix. Each offeror is responsible for verifying the condition of the property, developing a detailed scope of work and preparing a cost estimate for any proposed improvement plan. Generally, the lessee will not be able to upgrade amenities or expand the footprint of the shack. Expected Lease Commencement: The NPS anticipates the lease will commence in the late Spring of 2027. Building Codes & Zoning: For building codes and zoning, the Lease Premises are under exclusive jurisdiction of the Federal Government and are not subject to the zoning regulations of the Town of Truro or Barnstable County. However, the NPS will expect any work done on the property, where relevant, to meet the standards set forth by the 2024 ICC family of Codes and all codes referenced in those codes. For fire codes, follow all codes referenced in NPS Director�s Order #58 and NPS Reference Manual #58. Historic Preservation: Due to the historic nature of the offered property, the character-defining features of the building and surrounding landscape must be maintained. Any design and construction will be required to comply with one or more of the following: the Secretary of the Interior's Standards and Guidelines; National Historic Preservation Act (NHPA) and Section 106 compliance; National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA); NFPA 914 Code for Protection of Historical Structures. Please note that your planned Improvements may trigger compliance processes in accordance with one or more of the laws, regulations or policies listed above. The cost of any such compliance process as well as the costs of plan check, code review and construction inspections will be borne by the Lessee. Jurisdiction For purposes except building codes and zoning the Lease Premises are subject to concurrent jurisdiction. Under concurrent jurisdiction, Federal and State governments share the governmental authority, and unless otherwise stated, the laws of both governments are applicable. The Lessee must comply, at its sole cost and expense, with all Applicable Laws and Requirements (including Federal, State, and local laws, rules, regulations, requirements, and policies) in fulfilling its obligations under the Lease. It is the responsibility of the Lessee to determine whether it is subject to specific taxes and assessments and abide by those applicable statutes. Any comments made by the NPS in this RFP do not alter those responsibilities, if any, nor should they be construed to take a position nor express a view on behalf of the Lessee. Term of the Lease Offerors may propose a Lease Term up to a maximum of ten (10) years. Rent NPS is required under 36 CFR Part 18 to receive, at a minimum, Fair Market Value Rent (FMVR). The amount of rent will be negotiated subsequently with the selected offeror, provided that the final rent must at least equal the FMVR as determined by the NPS. The Lessor may offset Rent for the approved costs of completed Initial Improvements incurred by the Lessee in accordance with the requirements of the Lease. The Fair Market Value Annual Rent for the first year of the lease is $10,250.00. This rent will be subject to an annual Consumer Price Index (CPI) adjustment. Insurance During the term of this Lease, the Lessee shall maintain adequate Property and General Liability insurance coverage. Further information regarding insurance requirements can be found in Attachment A: Sample Lease. Insurance coverage amounts will be periodically reviewed by the NPS. These reviews seek to confirm that a Lessee has appropriate coverage considering any changing circumstances. Utilities The Armstrong shack does not have access to commercial utilities such as electricity, municipal water or municipal sewage systems. Alternative primitive systems, such as hand pumps and a wood stove have been used by current and prior occupants and most such systems are permitted for continued use. The gravity fed indoor toilet that empties into an approximate 100-gallon metal receptacle buried in the sand will not be permitted for continued use and must be replaced by an incinerating toilet or other acceptable alternative that meets current federal, state or local environmental regulations. Conventional utilities will not be extended to the dune shack.

title: Fire Alarm Control Panel Replacement Project (FACPR)
description: The University of California, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory requests proposals for design-build services for the design and construction of the Fire Alarm Control Panel Replacement Project ("FACPR" or "the Project"). The Project covers Buildings 2, 26, 33, and 76. Under this subcontract, the Design-Build Subcontractor will provide all professional design, engineering, procurement, installation, changeover, and commissioning services needed to replace the fire alarm control panels and backup battery systems. The Siemens Desigo system has been selected as LBNL's campus-standard fire alarm platform for this Project, no substitutions will be considered. Using one common platform supports compatibility with the existing mix of field devices, loops, and conventional circuits, and simplifies maintenance, training, and future parts availability across the site. The existing fire alarm wiring in the four buildings will generally remain in place. This Project replaces the central control equipment, not the complete building fire alarm systems. Fire alarm annunciation and notification devices and the StarLink cabinets themselves are not being replaced under this Project; StarLink cabinets will be relocated only as needed to follow the panels.

title: A Study on Vessel Design Challenge
description: The purpose of amendment no. 2 is to respond to the following questions. Question-4. Is MARAD open to all forms of propulsion to gain fuel efficiencies - for example, hybrid diesel-electric equipment with electric motors and batteries? Response-4. description: U.S. Maritime Administration (MARAD) A Study on Vessel Design Challenge RFP No. 693JF726R000016 REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP): The Maritime Administration�s (MARAD) Maritime Environmental and Technical Assistance (META) program is issuing a request for proposals (RFP) for a Vessel Design Challenge (Challenge). This Challenge intends to fund multiple design teams willing to undertake integrated design work to improve fuel efficiency and reduce vessel underwater radiated noise (URN) to create the next generation of U.S. vessels. Individual awards depend on number of designs proposed for the package. Awards are intended to be for not less than $150k and likely not more than $450k. Project completion timeline is 12-18 months. Total funding available is up to $1.25 million. PROGRAM DESCRIPTION: The META program (46 U.S.C. � 50307) is investigating the interconnections between broader fuel efficiency, reducing URN from vessels, and exploring potential co-benefits. It is the policy of the United States to revitalize and rebuild domestic maritime industries and workforce to promote national security and economic prosperity. Accomplishing this requires making United States-flagged and built vessels commercially competitive in international commerce, rebuilding America�s maritime manufacturing capabilities, and expanding and strengthening the recruitment, training, and retention of the relevant workforce. The most promising opportunities for optimizing fuel efficiency gains and achieving URN reductions are in the early ship design stage, using a systems approach. This requires intentional and integrated ship designs that prioritize fuel efficiency while simultaneously reducing URN. Advanced fluid dynamic modeling enables comparison among hull, engine, and propeller design and arrangement, providing valuable information to the industry about the return on investment (ROI) for various technology and design optimizations at the design phase. Individual technologies claim to provide efficiency and noise reduction benefits, but the additive cost-savings have not been quantified for applying technologies in series and demonstrating increased efficiencies across multiple areas. Recently published studies summarized the state of knowledge and availability of technologies that can be applied to vessels to improve energy efficiency while reducing vessel generated URN. Those reports crosswalk not only the interoperability of technologies and design elements, but the potential reductions, costs, and return on investment. The next phase is to demonstrate, through modeling, the benefits that can be realized through a systematic design approach integrating technologies with input from naval architects, shipyards, and technology suppliers on the efficacy of these approaches. By using this approach, Teams will begin at the drawing table to quantify the benefits of innovative technology integration into the design phase for application on new vessels. The Vessel Design Challenge is intended to facilitate the demonstration of novel vessel designs that meet or exceed international benchmarks for fuel efficiency and URN source levels. This Challenge is intended to fund multiple Design Teams willing to undertake this kind of integrated design work to create the next generation of U.S. vessels. PROPOSAL CONTENT Proposed Vessel Design: Design proposals can include: Existing projects that would be redesigned, Forthcoming projects that are just beginning the design specification phase, and Designs that are theoretical or more experimental which aim to create a new approach or design. There are no restrictions on eligible vessels, however, given the mission of the Maritime Administration, vessels should be commercially useful and generally would not include small watercraft, recreational vessels, or fisheries vessels. Eligible designs include vessels operating in coastal or inland waterways as well as the Great Lakes. Ideal proposals will be for new design approaches or design modifications that couple hull-machinery-propulsion approaches to maximize fuel efficiency, URN reduction, and ROI. Technologies should be centered around performance and demonstrating the feasibility and economic achievability of these combined approaches and should be dictated by capacity needs set by industry requirements (tug capacity, crew capacity, operations support, range, TEU, cargo etc.). Designs should note specifically the technology readiness level and the commercial availability of any technologies used. Design Team: The approach to the Challenge will include a design team. Teams should include description of partnerships, collaborations, and/or processes that will ensure success of the proposal. Further, proposals should identify the Team�s capabilities, related experience, techniques, or unique combinations of these that are integral factors for achieving the Challenge objectives to include experience that supports ability to successfully manage and achieve project goals and objectives of similar type and scope. Development of an ideal team should represent the concept of a design-build approach and include: Naval architect(s) Marine Engineer(s) Shipyard(s) Owner/operator/buyer (can be more than one) Technology provider(s) (including fuel supplier, as needed) May include operator/charter party, BCO, logistics partners, port/city/public entity, private financing partner. Teams may submit one or more vessel designs to the Challenge. Funding amounts will be based on: the number of vessel designs proposed their technology innovation, or a combination thereof One or all proposed designs may be funded depending on proposals. There is no limit to number of teams an organization can participate in, however, an organization may only �lead� one team/proposal. No identical teams with rotating �leads� will be permitted. Preference will be given to proposals with team leads represented by U.S. companies, those with U.S. headquarters, and those operating under the U.S. flag Methods: Proposals must include a detailed description of the design and modeling approaches that will be used to meet the Design Challenge Parameters as noted below, including those for fuel burn estimates and URN source level as well as modeling for return on investment and similar economic estimates and valuations. Timeline: The proposed plan should include the expected timeline (not to exceed 18 months) inclusive of kick off meetings with MARAD, design and technology integration and assessment, interim progress report detailing vessel design and technology application progress, data collection and analysis, and final report deliverables. Budget: All proposals must include a compete, detailed, and justifiable budget with general line items for various design components and stages including fuel, URN, and ROI evaluation and calculations. Budgets should demonstrate market conditions or similar that support these budget estimates. Description of key personnel, qualifications, and expected level of effort should also be included. Proposals may also include any additional considerations, outreach, or analysis recommended to achieve the goals of the project. Design Challenge Parameters Design specifications: The objective is for designs to meet or exceed these specifications for fuel efficiency improvement and noise reduction. Recognizing that this is a demonstration of technical feasibility and economic achievability, if these design specifications are not achievable, alternative efficiency and noise improvements should be documented demonstrating the current limits of technologies. These specifications should be considered aspirational to test the limits of the possible within the bounds of the practical. Energy Efficiency: 30% efficiency improvement over a typical vessel design with conventional hull and machinery arrangements and fuels. This Challenge intends to fund multiple design teams willing to undertake integrated design work to improve fuel efficiency and reduce vessel underwater radiated noise (URN) to create the next generation of U.S. vessels. Individual awards depend on number of designs proposed for the package. Awards are intended to be for not less than $150k and likely not more than $450k. Project completion timeline is 12-18 months. Total funding available is up to $1.25 million. PROGRAM DESCRIPTION: The META program (46 U.S.C. � 50307) is investigating the interconnections between broader fuel efficiency, reducing URN from vessels, and exploring potential co-benefits. It is the policy of the United States to revitalize and rebuild domestic maritime industries and workforce to promote national security and economic prosperity. Accomplishing this requires making United States-flagged and built vessels commercially competitive in international commerce, rebuilding America�s maritime manufacturing capabilities, and expanding and strengthening the recruitment, training, and retention of the relevant workforce. The most promising opportunities for optimizing fuel efficiency gains and achieving URN reductions are in the early ship design stage, using a systems approach. This requires intentional and integrated ship designs that prioritize fuel efficiency while simultaneously reducing URN. Advanced fluid dynamic modeling enables comparison among hull, engine, and propeller design and arrangement, providing valuable information to the industry about the return on investment (ROI) for various technology and design optimizations at the design phase. Individual technologies claim to provide efficiency and noise reduction benefits, but the additive cost-savings have not been quantified for applying technologies in series and demonstrating increased efficiencies across multiple areas. Recently published studies summarized the state of knowledge and availability of technologies that can be applied to vessels to improve energy efficiency while reducing vessel generated URN. Those reports crosswalk not only the interoperability of technologies and design elements, but the potential reductions, costs, and return on investment. The next phase is to demonstrate, through modeling, the benefits that can be realized through a systematic design approach integrating technologies with input from naval architects, shipyards, and technology suppliers on the efficacy of these approaches. By using this approach, Teams will begin at the drawing table to quantify the benefits of innovative technology integration into the design phase for application on new vessels. The Vessel Design Challenge is intended to facilitate the demonstration of novel vessel designs that meet or exceed international benchmarks for fuel efficiency and URN source levels. This Challenge is intended to fund multiple Design Teams willing to undertake this kind of integrated design work to create the next generation of U.S. vessels. Eligible designs include vessels operating in coastal or inland waterways as well as the Great Lakes. Technologies should be centered around performance and demonstrating the feasibility and economic achievability of these combined approaches and should be dictated by capacity needs set by industry requirements (tug capacity, crew capacity, operations support, range, TEU, cargo etc.). title: Germany – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – V358_2026 - CE-NDEI - Extension of XPS Erlangen (HI-ERN)
description: Das Helmholtz-Zentrum Berlin für Materialien und Energie GmbH (HZB) ist ein unabhängiges wissenschaftliches Forschungszentrum unter dem Dach der Helmholtz-Gemeinschaft mit Standorten in Berlin-Adlershof und Wannsee. Der Elektronen-Speicherring BESSY II liefert hochbrillante Synchrotronstrahlung – vom Terahertz- bis in den Röntgenbereich. Mit seinem Schwerpunkt auf VUV- und weicher Röntgenstrahlung eignet sich BESSY II hervorragend für die Analyse von Energiematerialien und Dünnschichtsystemen. Die Weiterentwicklung der Instrumentierung sowie die Erarbeitung eines Konzepts für eine Nachfolgequelle (BESSY III) zählen zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben der kommenden Jahre. An unserem Elektronen-Speicherring BESSY II verzeichnen wir jährlich durchschnittlich 2700 Besuche von Gastforschenden aus 28 Ländern. Jährlich erscheinen 500 bis 600 wissenschaftliche Publikationen, die auf Messungen an BESSY II (sowie bis Ende 2019 auch an BER II) basieren. Gruppe CE-NDEI Die Forschungsaktivitäten der Gruppe „Dynamic Electrocatalytic Interfaces“ (CE-NDEI) konzentrieren sich darauf, die dynamischen Veränderungen katalytischer Oberflächen unter realen Reaktionsbedingungen zu verstehen. Die Gruppe konzipiert und fertigt nanostrukturierte, katalytisch aktive Dünnschicht-Modelloberflächen. Sie untersucht systematisch die strukturellen und zusammensetzungsbezogenen Veränderungen, die während katalytischer Prozesse auftreten, sowie deren Einfluss auf Reaktionsmechanismen und Kinetik in der Elektrokatalyse. Diese Forschung erfolgt durch eine Kombination komplementärer *ex-situ*- und *in-situ*-Experimentierverfahren. Ein zentrales Ziel ist ein detailliertes mechanistisches Verständnis chemischer Prozesse an komplexen, sich dynamisch entwickelnden Grenzflächen – insbesondere bei elektrokatalytischen Reaktionen, die für Technologien zur Energieumwandlung und Energiespeicherung relevant sind. Letztlich zielt die Arbeit darauf ab, die Stabilitätsgrenzen von Elektrokatalysatormaterialien zu überwinden. Das methodische Spektrum der Gruppe umfasst eine Vielzahl physikalischer Gasphasenabscheidungsverfahren (PVD), moderne elektrochemische Charakterisierungsmethoden, Atomsonden-Tomographie sowie Röntgen-Photoelektronenspektroskopie – einschließlich Messungen an Synchrotronstrahlungsquellen. Die Arbeitsgruppe ist am Helmholtz-Institut Erlangen-Nürnberg für Erneuerbare Energien (HI ERN) angesiedelt und arbeitet eng mit dem HI ERN, dem Forschungszentrum Jülich (FZJ) sowie der Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU) zusammen. Erweiterung der XPS-Kapazitäten der Arbeitsgruppe CE-NDEI Um die Forschungsmöglichkeiten der Arbeitsgruppe CE-NDEI am HZB auszubauen und die Zusammenarbeit mit dem HI ERN sowie der FAU im Bereich der In-situ-Charakterisierung von Mehrkomponenten-Katalysatormaterialien zu fördern, ist die Anschaffung eines laborbasierten Systems zur Röntgenabsorptionsfeinstruktur-Analyse (XAFS) geplant. Dieses System ermöglicht die In-situ-Untersuchung der elektronischen Struktur von Katalysatoren auf Basis von Übergangsmetallen – sowohl im Transmissions- als auch im Fluoreszenzmodus – und deckt einen Energiebereich von etwa 4,5 bis 25 keV ab (weitere Spezifikationen finden Sie in der separaten technischen Beschreibung). Durch die Ergänzung der bereits vorhandenen Möglichkeiten zur Röntgenphotoelektronenspektroskopie (XPS) in der Arbeitsgruppe CE-NDEI erlaubt der neue XAFS-Aufbau detaillierte Einblicke in die lokale elektronische und strukturelle Umgebung aktiver Katalysatorkomponenten unter realistischen Betriebsbedingungen. Dieser Fortschritt wird das Verständnis von Struktur-Funktions-Beziehungen in katalytischen Systemen maßgeblich vertiefen. Zudem dürfte die Implementierung dieses laborbasierten XAFS-Systems das Interesse von Forschenden am HI ERN/FZJ sowie an der FAU an In-situ-Spektroskopieverfahren – einschließlich der am BESSY II verfügbaren synchrotronbasierten Methoden – steigern. Auf diese Weise wird die strategische Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem HZB, dem HI ERN und dem FZJ weiter gestärkt. Gemäß Beschreibung der technischen und funktionalen Mindestanforderungen soll ein laborbasiertes Röntgenspektrometer für die Röntgenabsorptionsfeinstruktur-Analyse (XAFS) beschafft werden, das optional auch Röntgenemissionsspektroskopie (XES) ermöglicht. Das Gerät soll in der Lage sein, XANES- und EXAFS-Daten von einer Qualität zu liefern, die mit der an Synchrotronanlagen erzielbaren Qualität vergleichbar ist. Dies soll Forschung und Entwicklung in Bereichen wie Materialwissenschaften, Katalyse, Energiematerialien und verwandten Feldern ermöglichen, ohne dass ein Zugang zu Synchrotronanlagen erforderlich ist. Die technischen Spezifikationen sowie der Leistungsumfang für den Auftragnehmer hinsichtlich der mechanischen Konstruktion und des Baus des Spektrometers sind in den Vergabeunterlagen festgeschrieben. Die Einhaltung dieser Spezifikationen ist durch geeignete Methoden nachzuweisen. Das System muss für den regulären Laboreinsatz geeignet sein und den geltenden Sicherheitsnormen entsprechen. Der Aufbau muss gewährleisten, dass Proben unter den definierten Spezifikationen untersucht werden können.

title: Norway – Construction work – U2940 EFU-10988 Storetveit school - procurement of a turnkey contractor
description: Bergen municipality, the Development Department, hereby invites tenderers to a competition for a contract for a turnkey contract in the project U2940 Storetveit School. Storetveit secondary school needs upgrading and expanded capacity to meet the current educational and technical requirements, in addition to the expected increase in pupil numbers. title: Norway – Research services – Openness and inclusion - police interaction with the entire population
description: The aim of the research assignment is to obtain knowledge about how different groups of the population experience the police, what conditions affect the interaction between police and inhabitants, and how the police can ensure that different perspectives and experiences are heard and safeguarded. There is a need for knowledge about whether there are groups that find that they are not heard, how the police reach out to groups that to a small degree contact the police on their own initiative and how different forms of communication and dialogue are experienced by different groups. The research shall provide a better knowledge basis for how the police can strengthen the dialogue with the population, adapt communication and work forms to different target groups and develop services that safeguard legal security, equal treatment and high quality. The research shall also contribute with knowledge on the connection between transparency, inclusion, trust and the police's legitimacy, as well as the impact this can have on society's resilience. See further information in the tender documentation.

title: Switzerland – Works for complete or part construction and civil engineering work – EPFL - Entreprise Totale - Assainissement et bouclage d'un réseau d'eaux industrielles, y.c. création d'une station de découplage hydraulique au bord du lac contre la lutte de la propagation des Moules Quagga
description: Le marché porte sur l’étude et la construction en Entreprise Totale des parties d’ouvrages suivantes : 1. Nouvelle station de découplage (SDD) y compris les adaptations hydrauliques dans les stations de pompage (SPP), les conduites de liaison SPP et SDD et les conduites de rejet au lac entre le bâtiment SDD et la chambre de visite d’interface des conduites CCU/SDD. 2. Nouvelles conduites de liaison (terrestres) SDD-PDR jusqu’au poste de redistribution PDR, y compris la création d’un nouveau local de pompes dans l’actuel parking au sous-sol du bâtiment BS de l’EPFL. 3. Rénovation du réseau de distribution dans les galeries EPFL depuis le poste PDR jusqu’aux différentes sous-stations propres à chaque bâtiment du campus y compris la nouvelle conduite de retour et les adaptations hydrauliques à la CCT. L’Entreprise Totale interviendra de la phase « 32. Projet d’ouvrage » jusqu’à la phase « 53. Mise en service, achèvement ». L’élément déclencheur et l’objectif primordial du projet est la protection contre la prolifération des moules Quagga dans nos conduites et la sécurisation du réseau de refroidissement. Cependant, la vétusté des conduites ainsi que nos capacités en refroidissement actuelles, induisent une réflexion globale sur l’avenir de l’ensemble du site de l’EPFL et l’UNIL à Ecublens. De ce fait, le projet comprend les trois objectifs ci-dessous : 1. Protection totale des conduites du réseau de refroidissement contre la prolifération des moules Quagga, grâce au découplage hydraulique et à un nouveau réseau en boucle fermée. 2. Augmentation des capacités en refroidissement afin de subvenir aux besoins futurs dus aux nouveaux bâtiments et à l’augmentation de la demande des bâtiments existants. 3. Réduction des coûts d’exploitation et optimisation énergétique grâce au bouclage du réseau. Veuillez consulter le cahier des charges et ses annexes pour plus de renseignement.
